attributes.description: Tier 2 detail dashboard scoped to a single Google Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL instance from metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*. Reached by drilling down from [GCP OTel] Cloud SQL PostgreSQL Overview, which applies an instance filter matching both database_id (instance metrics) and resource_id (Query Insights). Covers availability, capacity, traffic and errors, connections, I/O and cache, vacuum and wraparound, and Query Insights.

query.esql: ROW `Open` = "< Overview"
ROW `Open` = "< Overview"

embeddableConfig.description: Navigation tile — returns to the Cloud SQL PostgreSQL overview dashboard, carrying the current time range.

esql_query:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS instance_id = MAX(database_id)
| EVAL instance_name = MV_LAST(SPLIT(instance_id, ":"))
| LIMIT 1
embeddableConfig.template:
{% for row in rows %}
{% if row["instance_name"].value %}{{ row["instance_name"].value }}{% else %}Cloud SQL PostgreSQL instance{% endif %}
{% endfor %}

query.esql: ROW `Open` = "View metrics in Discover"
ROW `Open` = "View metrics in Discover"

embeddableConfig.description: Navigation tile — opens this instance's raw metric documents in Discover for the current time range.

esql_query:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS st = MAX(attributes.state) WHERE `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/instance_state` == 1,
        up = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/up`)), cores = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/reserved_cores`)),
        memq = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/quota`)), diskq = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/quota`)),
        disk = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/utilization`)), cpu = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`))),
        mem = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`))), conns = SUM(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/num_backends`)),
        r = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime`)) WHERE `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime` > 0 AND `cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime` < 55,
        fo = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/available_for_failover`))
  BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), instance_id = database_id, project_id, region
| STATS state = LAST(st, CASE(st IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)), last_up = LAST(up, CASE(up IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        last_reserved_cores = LAST(cores, CASE(cores IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        last_memory_quota = LAST(memq, CASE(memq IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        last_disk_quota = LAST(diskq, CASE(diskq IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        last_disk_utilization = LAST(disk, CASE(disk IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        avg_cpu_utilization = AVG(cpu), avg_memory_utilization = AVG(mem),
        last_connections = LAST(conns, CASE(conns IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)),
        restarts = COALESCE(SUM(r), 0), last_failover = LAST(fo, CASE(fo IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL))
  BY instance_id, project_id, region
| SORT avg_cpu_utilization DESC
| LIMIT 1

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS _v = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)), _live = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS v = SUM(_v), mins = COUNT(*) WHERE _live > 0
| EVAL `Transactions/s` = CASE(mins > 0, ROUND(v / (mins * 60.0), 2), NULL)
| KEEP `Transactions/s`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS _v = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)), _live = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| STATS v = SUM(_v), mins = COUNT(*) WHERE _live > 0
| EVAL `Transactions/s` = CASE(mins > 0, ROUND(v / (mins * 60.0), 2), NULL)
| KEEP `Transactions/s`

embeddableConfig.description: Committed plus rolled-back transactions per second over the selected range: one-minute delta counts divided by the minutes the instance was reporting, the same method as the TPS chart.
embeddableConfig.title: Transactions/s

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS total = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)),
        rb = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)) WHERE attributes.transaction_type == "rollback"
| EVAL `Rollback rate %` = CASE(total > 0, ROUND(COALESCE(rb, TO_LONG(0)) * 100.0 / total, 2), NULL)
| KEEP `Rollback rate %`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS total = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)),
        rb = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)) WHERE attributes.transaction_type == "rollback"
| EVAL `Rollback rate %` = CASE(total > 0, ROUND(COALESCE(rb, TO_LONG(0)) * 100.0 / total, 2), NULL)
| KEEP `Rollback rate %`

embeddableConfig.description: Rolled-back transactions as a percentage of all transactions. Green < 1%, yellow 1–5%, red ≥ 5%.
embeddableConfig.title: Rollback rate %

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS hit = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/blocks_read_count`)) WHERE attributes.source == "buffer_cache",
        miss = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/blocks_read_count`)) WHERE attributes.source == "disk"
| EVAL h = COALESCE(hit, TO_LONG(0)), m = COALESCE(miss, TO_LONG(0))
| EVAL `Buffer cache hit %` = CASE(h + m > 0, ROUND(h * 100.0 / (h + m), 2), NULL)
| KEEP `Buffer cache hit %`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS hit = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/blocks_read_count`)) WHERE attributes.source == "buffer_cache",
        miss = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/blocks_read_count`)) WHERE attributes.source == "disk"
| EVAL h = COALESCE(hit, TO_LONG(0)), m = COALESCE(miss, TO_LONG(0))
| EVAL `Buffer cache hit %` = CASE(h + m > 0, ROUND(h * 100.0 / (h + m), 2), NULL)
| KEEP `Buffer cache hit %`

embeddableConfig.description: Share of block reads served from the buffer cache instead of disk. Google recommends keeping it above 99%; lower means the working set no longer fits in memory. Red < 95%, yellow 95–99%, green ≥ 99%.
embeddableConfig.title: Buffer cache hit %

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS xid = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_id_utilization`)) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), database_id
| STATS xid = LAST(xid, CASE(xid IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)) BY database_id
| STATS `XID utilization %` = ROUND(MAX(xid) * 100, 2)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS xid = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_id_utilization`)) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), database_id
| STATS xid = LAST(xid, CASE(xid IS NOT NULL, `@timestamp`, NULL)) BY database_id
| STATS `XID utilization %` = ROUND(MAX(xid) * 100, 2)

embeddableConfig.description: Share of the transaction ID space consumed (wraparound risk). At 100% PostgreSQL forces a read-only shutdown. Green < 50%, yellow 50–80%, red ≥ 80%.
embeddableConfig.title: XID utilization %

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS `v` = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/instance_state`)) BY `attributes.state`, `bucket` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE `v` == 1

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS `v` = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/instance_state`)) BY `attributes.state`, `bucket` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE `v` == 1

embeddableConfig.description: Instance state reported by Cloud SQL in each time bucket (one-hot instance_state). A healthy instance shows a solid RUNNING band; MAINTENANCE, SUSPENDED or FAILED segments show when and for how long it was not serving.
embeddableConfig.title: Instance state over time

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS min_uptime = MIN(MIN_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS min_uptime = MIN(MIN_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Lowest one-minute uptime sample in each time bucket. A flat line at 60 s is healthy; dips below 55 s mark a restart and gaps mean the instance reported nothing at all.
embeddableConfig.title: Uptime per bucket (restart detector)

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS cpu_pct = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`))) * 100, cores = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/reserved_cores`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS cpu_pct = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/utilization`))) * 100, cores = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/cpu/reserved_cores`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Average CPU utilization (left axis) against the reserved vCPU count (right axis). Sustained utilization above 80% means the tier is too small for the workload; a step in reserved cores marks a tier change.
embeddableConfig.title: CPU utilization vs reserved cores

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS `usage` = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/usage`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/usage`))), `total_usage` = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/total_usage`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/total_usage`))), `quota` = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/quota`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS `usage` = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/usage`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/usage`))), `total_usage` = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/total_usage`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/total_usage`))), `quota` = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/quota`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Memory in use excluding buffer/cache (database/memory/usage), total memory in use including buffer/cache (database/memory/total_usage), and the instance memory quota, as defined in Google Cloud Monitoring. Memory utilization is usage divided by the quota. Usage approaching the quota line risks an out-of-memory restart; buffer/cache counted in total usage can be reclaimed by the operating system.
embeddableConfig.title: Memory usage vs quota

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS `used` = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/bytes_used`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/bytes_used`))), `quota` = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/quota`)) BY `bucket` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS `used` = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/bytes_used`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/bytes_used`))), `quota` = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/quota`)) BY `bucket` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Bytes used on the data disk against the provisioned disk quota. The instance goes read-only when usage reaches the quota; enable automatic storage increase or resize well before the lines meet.
embeddableConfig.title: Disk usage vs quota

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS `mem_pct` = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`))) * 100, `disk_pct` = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/utilization`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/utilization`))) * 100 BY bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS `mem_pct` = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/memory/utilization`))) * 100, `disk_pct` = (SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/utilization`)) / SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/disk/utilization`))) * 100 BY bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Memory and disk utilization as a percentage of their quotas on one axis, for quickly spotting which resource is closer to its limit.
embeddableConfig.title: Memory and disk utilization

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS _v0 = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)), _live = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), attributes.transaction_type
| INLINE STATS _mins = COUNT_DISTINCT(`@timestamp`) WHERE _live > 0 BY bucket = BUCKET(`@timestamp`, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE attributes.transaction_type IS NOT NULL
| STATS `TPS` = SUM(_v0) / (MAX(_mins) * 60.0) BY bucket, attributes.transaction_type

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS _v0 = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)), _live = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), attributes.transaction_type
| INLINE STATS _mins = COUNT_DISTINCT(`@timestamp`) WHERE _live > 0 BY bucket = BUCKET(`@timestamp`, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE attributes.transaction_type IS NOT NULL
| STATS `TPS` = SUM(_v0) / (MAX(_mins) * 60.0) BY bucket, attributes.transaction_type

embeddableConfig.description: Committed and rolled-back transactions per second, from one-minute delta counts divided by the minutes that reported data in each bucket. A growing rollback band points at application errors, serialization failures or deadlocks.
embeddableConfig.title: TPS by commit vs rollback

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS rb = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)) WHERE attributes.transaction_type == "rollback", tx = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Rollback ratio` = CASE(tx > 0, COALESCE(rb, 0) * 100.0 / tx, NULL)
| KEEP bucket, `Rollback ratio`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS rb = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)) WHERE attributes.transaction_type == "rollback", tx = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Rollback ratio` = CASE(tx > 0, COALESCE(rb, 0) * 100.0 / tx, NULL)
| KEEP bucket, `Rollback ratio`

embeddableConfig.description: Rolled-back transactions as a percentage of all transactions in each bucket. Below 1% is normal; a sustained rise means the application is failing or retrying transactions.
embeddableConfig.title: Rollback ratio

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS _v0 = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/statements_executed_count`)), _live = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime`)) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), attributes.operation_type
| INLINE STATS _mins = COUNT_DISTINCT(`@timestamp`) WHERE _live > 0 BY bucket = BUCKET(`@timestamp`, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE attributes.operation_type IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Statements per second` = SUM(_v0) / (MAX(_mins) * 60.0) BY bucket, attributes.operation_type

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS _v0 = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/statements_executed_count`)), _live = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime`)) BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), attributes.operation_type
| INLINE STATS _mins = COUNT_DISTINCT(`@timestamp`) WHERE _live > 0 BY bucket = BUCKET(`@timestamp`, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| WHERE attributes.operation_type IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Statements per second` = SUM(_v0) / (MAX(_mins) * 60.0) BY bucket, attributes.operation_type

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS `Deadlocks` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/deadlock_count`)) BY `bucket` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS `Deadlocks` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/deadlock_count`)) BY `bucket` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Deadlocks detected in each time bucket. Any non-zero bar means two transactions blocked each other and one was aborted; correlate with the rollback ratio.
embeddableConfig.title: Deadlocks over time

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudsql_postgresql.otel-*
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND gcp.resource_type == "cloudsql_database"
| STATS tx = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)),
        rb = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/transaction_count`)) WHERE attributes.transaction_type == "rollback",
        conns = SUM(MAX_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/num_backends`)), newc = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/new_connection_count`)),
        dl = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/deadlock_count`)), tmp = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/temp_bytes_written_count`)),
        hit = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/blocks_read_count`)) WHERE attributes.source == "buffer_cache",
        miss = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/postgresql/blocks_read_count`)) WHERE attributes.source == "disk",
        _live = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`cloudsql.googleapis.com/database/uptime`))
  BY `@timestamp` = TBUCKET(1 minute), attributes.database
